source.label: Game Plan Cyclopes rules of play

supportingSources.label: Cyclopes rules and play with designer Roger Sharpe

strategy.overview: Cyclopes builds toward two-ball Multiball by completing both halves of C-Y-C-L-O-P-E-S. Complete the C-Y-C-L and O-P-E-S target groups to light the top-right hole, then shoot that hole to start Multiball. Each half also advances Bonus X and raises its matching spinner value. Complete M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S to light the center target and rotating Extra Ball; hit the flashing center target to raise Monster Bonus and light the top hole to collect it. Repeated hits to the E-Y-E-S captive-ball area raise its value.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the C-Y-C-L and O-P-E-S target groups, then shoot the lit top-right hole to start two-ball Multiball. Each group also advances Bonus X and raises one spinner. Complete M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S, hit the flashing center target, then shoot the lit top hole to collect Monster Bonus.
strategy.summary: Finish C-Y-C-L and O-P-E-S first so the same target work builds spinner value, Bonus X, and Multiball. If M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S is nearly complete, finish it and collect Monster Bonus before returning to the harder captive-ball shots.

quickInfo.name: Build Monster Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Complete M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S, then hit the flashing center target.

steps.text: Complete the C-Y-C-L target group to advance Bonus X and raise the left spinner value.
Complete the O-P-E-S target group to advance Bonus X and raise the right spinner value.
After both halves are complete, shoot the lit top-right hole to start two-ball Multiball.
During controlled play, use the now-higher-value spinners and continue working whichever letter group is safest to reach.

alternatives.title: Monster Bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S targets are safer than the two CYCLOPES groups or already close to complete.

steps.text: Complete M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S to light the center target and the rotating Extra Ball award.
Hit the center target while it flashes to raise Monster Bonus and light the top hole.
Shoot the lit top hole to collect Monster Bonus before restarting the sequence.
Keep completing C-Y-C-L and O-P-E-S to advance Bonus X.
Reach 10x to light Special at its indicated shot.

machineSetup: Test both CYCLOPES target groups, both spinners, the top-right Multiball hole, the M-O-N-S-T-E-R-S targets, center target, top bonus hole, and E-Y-E-S captive-ball area.
On multiplayer games, explain that the highest score after normal play receives a timed Bonus Ball; the drop-target banks add time during that ball.

cautions.issue: The timed Bonus Ball is a multiplayer-only competition feature.
cautions.response: Do not plan around it in a one-player game; in multiplayer, the highest score earns it after normal play ends.
